corrected_scope: Exact egg BE keys are Parent1Data/Parent2Data (earlier proposal Parent1/2 were shorthand, not literal keys). Egg BE load instantiates a ParentData only when the corresponding key exists; omitting a key does not explicitly clear an existing in-memory parent.

Native CompoundTag.merge recursively merges an incoming compound when the existing value is also a compound. An empty incoming compound has no keys to iterate, so it does not clear a preexisting populated parent compound. It is wrong to infer that every empty parent tag on stacking resets an existing parent to zero/default.

The earlier default-field observation is limited to actually constructing ParentData from an empty compound, e.g. an empty compound copied into a tag without an old parent payload. getInt returns0 when the numeric field is absent; the enum constructor clamps that ordinal to GREEN. Whether this occurs depends on the pre-merge destination tag and conditional BE load.

Nonempty new parent fields can overwrite or recursively merge existing fields; absent incoming keys can remain. The placement chain stores a shared BE parent pair, not one pair per EGGS member. Actual stacking, operator permission, external callbacks, save/reopen, entity addition and genetic offspring behavior remain unverified.
reason: Peer commentary identified the NBT ambiguity before its turn failed429; coordinator then independently read exact full native getInt/getCompound/merge methods and re-read complete egg BE to verify the interpretation. Commentary is not used as an independent acceptance receipt.
